title: An anchor must be separated from the flow collection it marks
notes: An anchor name is made of non-space characters that are not flow indicators, so the name ends at `[`. Properties are followed by white space before the content (production 96 and the node productions that use it), and an empty node cannot be followed by a collection. `[` is the first character that cannot belong.

provenance.reference: A reader that accepted an anchor written directly against the opening bracket.
